fact: fleet-wide facts are computed once per sweep
why_not_a_cache: explicit lifetime, immutable for one sweep, discarded on exit. With no scope open every call computes, which is byte-for-byte the pre-Gate-166 behaviour. A scope opened for another organization is BYPASSED rather than answered from - a mismatch costs time, never correctness.
why_not_thread_local: all 57 API route modules are sync, so Starlette runs them in anyio's worker threadpool with REUSED workers; thread-local state would leak one request's scope into the next request that landed on the same worker
